failures.description: Critical and high severity vulnerabilities remain unpatched.
failures.recommendation: Implement automated patch management and enforce patching SLAs for critical and high vulnerabilities.

failures.description: A successful attack was simulated without evidence of timely detection.
failures.recommendation: Implement continuous security monitoring, intrusion detection, centralized logging, and alerting.

failures.description: A patch management policy exists, but the critical Struts vulnerability remains unpatched.
failures.evidence: Patch Management Policy exists in governance records.
failures.recommendation: Ensure policies are implemented through enforceable procedures, ownership, monitoring, and accountability.

failures.description: A vulnerability management policy exists while critical vulnerabilities remain unresolved.
failures.recommendation: Establish formal vulnerability remediation timelines and verify closure of critical findings.

failures.description: Patch compliance is measured, but critical vulnerabilities remain unresolved.
failures.evidence: Patch Compliance metric exists in governance records.
failures.recommendation: Use security metrics to drive corrective action and escalate failures to appropriate leadership.

failures.description: Web and database systems are not adequately segmented.
failures.evidence: Network segmentation control has not been implemented.
failures.recommendation: Implement network segmentation and restrict communication between public-facing and backend systems.

failures.description: Database security configuration has not been hardened.
failures.recommendation: Remove default credentials, enforce strong authentication, apply least privilege, and secure database access.
